name: FUJIX Ltd.
summary: FUJIX Ltd. manufactures, distributes, and trades in various sewing and embroidery thread in Japan and internationally. The company offers industrial sewing and embroidery threads comprising decorative, machine embroidery, special use, and other threads. It also provides home-use sewing threads, such as synthetic fiber sewing, cotton sewing, silk sewing, lock sewing, special use, decorative, temari, patchwork, and other threads. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
